definitions.title: The Shell Method Formula
definitions.latex: V = 2\pi \int_a^b (\text{shell radius})(\text{shell height}) dx = 2\pi \int_a^b x \, f(x) \, dx
definitions.statement: When revolving a region about a vertical axis, the solid can be sliced into concentric cylindrical shells of radius r(x), height h(x), and thickness dx.
conditions: Axis of rotation is parallel to the height of the cylindrical shell
definitions.explanation: The shell method avoids having to invert equations when solving for x in terms of y is algebraically intractable.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Shell volume = 2pi times integral of (radius)(height) times thickness.
